# spaceman_event_template (Data Source)

An event template of the catalog by slug, including the built-in presets (`GET /event-templates`): use `latest_version_id` in a `spaceman_event_subscription`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spaceman_event_template" "github_issues" {
  slug = "github-issue"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/provider/docs_test.go -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The template's slug.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Seeded from a verified upstream contract.
- `id` (String) The template ID.
- `latest_version` (Number) Number of the latest published version.
- `latest_version_id` (String) ID of the latest published version.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `subject` (String) The latest version's subject filter (may contain `{{vars.x}}`).
